title: Black Series
medium: Mixed media on MDF, fabric, plaster, epoxy
meta: Medium: Mixed media on MDF (plywood), fabric, plaster, epoxy resin
Framing: Gloss-finished with epoxy resin; set in custom black wood frame
statement:
BLACK SERIES — VOID, a dense and immersive black surface formed from sculpted fabric and plaster, sealed in glossy epoxy. BLACK SERIES — VOID invites stillness. The folds feel heavy and suspended, like frozen motion or silenced emotion. It's about weight, protection, and quiet power — not absence, but presence in the dark.

BLACK SERIES — HOLE pulses with tension and movement. The black-and-green surface feels explosive, like energy pulling toward a center. This piece spirals inward—visually and emotionally. Built from layers of plaster and epoxy resin. A visual metaphor for introspection, excavation, or even emotional burnout.
